description: This file contains implementations of Metal-accelerated tensor operations such as 'addmm' and 'linear' for PyTorch, specifically optimized for iOS/macOS platforms using Metal APIs. It includes functions for matrix multiplication, tensor reshaping, and interfacing with Metal command buffers and related objects, with registration of these functions for external use.

methods.name: addmm
methods.description: Performs a Metal-accelerated matrix multiplication plus bias addition, optimized for Metal devices, with input validation and tensor reshaping.

methods.name: linear
methods.description: Prepack-accelerated linear operation for tensors using Metal, managing Metal-specific resources and execution.

methods.name: linear_run
methods.description: Wrapper function that executes the prepacked linear operation within the Metal context.
